mechanism: Retain the original signed return numerator, direction law, wall-clock opportunity, literal threshold and every execution/risk/position-management rule. For only the three original standard-deviation-normalized entry features, divide the realized original numerator by a conditional RMS scale forecast before its return window began. This can change which original scheduled signals pass, including formerly subthreshold signals, but is not a separate entry generator. Pressure and RC range-ratio signals remain exact. Passive position management always calls its unchanged original feature; only fresh entry evaluation receives the forecast scale.

cross.symbol: US100 minus half US30 and US500

passive.original_entry: abs(feature)>=1 when the completed decision bar is within 12:00<=hour<16:00, original contrarian direction

inputs.own_slice: 2023-12-01 through 2026-01-01 exclusive; timestamp-cut before decoding numeric price fields. Preserve source hashes before and after physical own copies. No candidate 2026 value.
inputs.bars: Aggregate observed native M1 bars into their unshifted server M15/H1 buckets, retaining partial trading-session buckets as native bars rather than requiring a future complete-minute count. An origin uses only bars whose nominal close is available. Missing past data is a declared unavailable forecast, not a future-dependent exclusion.
inputs.cross_alignment: For a cross forecast require all three arrays' last 121 H1 bar timestamps to agree. Otherwise retain the original entry scale and record causal unavailability. The original source only checks latest synchronization, so do not silently treat an intersection-compressed history as that original series. All three constituents must remain aligned through a scored one-bar label; unavailable future labels are retained and never delete an earlier forecast.
inputs.clock: Original native server epochs, no UTC relabeling or external session/calendar data. A future label becomes available at the nominal close of its final observed native bar. Online updates require availability strictly earlier than the next forecast origin; equal-time labels wait. Missing-bar gaps remain visible.
inputs.population: Every causally available native origin in 2024 for fit and in 2025 for fixed selection, independent of signal strength, order admission or profit. Forecast labels do not depend on whether a candidate takes a trade. Record all forecast/unavailable/immature counts, all calendar dates and original scheduled-signal comparisons.

forecast.anchor: At the close of origin bar j, compute sample variance v0 of the last W completed one-bar log returns through j. For cross, each return is the original relative one-bar return. Require finite positive v0 and the declared causal source alignment.
forecast.target: Y=(sum of the next L one-bar returns)^2/(L*v0), from the original future numerator. Raw nonnegative Y is retained without profit or outlier selection. This is a conditional second-moment/RMS forecast, not a claim of centered conditional variance when drift exists.
raw_features: sin(2*pi*origin native server minute of day/1440)
cos(2*pi*origin native server minute of day/1440)
sin(4*pi*origin native server minute of day/1440)
cos(4*pi*origin native server minute of day/1440)
forecast.normalization: Per-series means/SD fitted on complete 2024 targets available strictly before 2025; SD floor 1e-6, standardized feature clip [-6,6], prepend intercept. No selection or full-path normalization.
forecast.model: One fresh 8-coefficient model per series. z=x*w; predicted ratio V=exp(3*tanh(z/3)); entry RMS denominator=sqrt(L*v0*V). A fresh float32 ONNX MatMul/Div/Tanh/Mul/Exp graph takes x[1,8] and own dynamic w[8,1] and returns V[1,1]. No imported closed source, weights or learner state.
forecast.fit: All complete 2024 labels, at least 256 per series. Minimize mean(log(V)+Y/V)+0.01*sum(nonintercept w^2), one deterministic L-BFGS-B fit from zero, analytic gradient, maxiter 500, ftol 1e-12. A solver failure is an engineering correction, not a second hyperparameter search. No clipping of fit targets. Fit-period end labels crossing into 2025 are not fitted.
forecast.constant_reference: Per-series constant ratio clip(mean complete 2024 Y,exp(-3),exp(3)), frozen once. Also report ratio-one original ex-ante rolling-variance reference.
forecast.static: Freeze all three fitted coefficient vectors throughout selection and confirmation.
forecast.online: Initialize all three vectors from the identical fit and start an empty pending queue at 2025. For every mature complete label with availability < origin, use current coefficients to compute gradient (1-Y/V)*(1-tanh(z/3)^2)*stored x, cap its Euclidean norm at 10, then w -= 0.001*gradient. No online penalty, forgetting, seed, refit, replay or per-component selection. Preserve the original forecast for prequential loss. Labels remain observed regardless of any eventual trade action.
forecast.entry_mapping: At an entry evaluation after bar n, retrieve the forecast originally made after bar n-L for exactly the original numerator window. Divide the original numerator by its stored forecast RMS. Preserve original raw numerator and original feature in evidence. If a required origin predates the empty 2025 learner start or has declared source unavailability, retain the original feature and record the reason; never fabricate a retrospective online forecast. Missing/nonfinite inference is an engineering fault, not a quiet favorable fallback.
forecast.causal_catchup: Native implementation may process missed completed market bars in chronological order, using only values available at each bar's origin and strict label maturity. No current partial bar, future completed bar, future finalization check or actual future clock is a feature. Original bar gaps and original array semantics remain attributed.

selection.period: Full 2025, both half-years, whole static/online bundle together, 2024 fit unchanged.
selection.loss: For scoring only use Yplus=max(Y,1e-10), QLIKE=Yplus/V-log(Yplus/V)-1. This nonnegative excess over the per-observation oracle permits a meaningful proportional comparison; report raw log(V)+Y/V as well. Give each of the three series equal weight in pooled means, not each bar.
gates: At least 95% of available original scheduled evaluations in each series have an ex-ante forecast after the initial L-bar warmup, and at least 99% of generated forecasts whose labels are due within 2025 have complete labels
Pooled QLIKE at least 2% below the frozen train-only constant reference; neither half-year pooled mean worse than the constant reference
No one series pooled QLIKE more than 5% worse than its constant reference
At least 5% of scheduled original signal-pass flags change across the three series; each series retains between 75% and 150% of its original unconstrained scheduled signal-pass supply
selection.ranking: Among whole qualifying roles choose lower equal-series pooled QLIKE, static on exact tie. Never mix the static/online role by series. Freeze exactly one before any candidate 2026 numeric value or native outcome. If neither qualifies close the complete bundle; no nearby horizon, normalization, clock feature, coefficient model, bound, update step, signal subgroup or threshold rescue.
selection.limits: Predictive and unconstrained signal-supply selection only. It cannot establish profit, attainable occupancy, stops, costs, lot compounding or native DD. Exact V7 gates and account feedback are resolved only natively.

conditional_native.period: Full 2025 through 2026-09-01 exclusive. Candidate Jan-Jun 2026 and Jul-Aug 2026 remain unopened before the single survivor freeze. One continuous fresh 2025 learning start, no yearly reset or checkpoint adoption.
conditional_native.source: One-time physical derivation from the 21-file frozen V7R parent into this campaign only. Distinct tester-only exact control and survivor identities, Magic, Include, state, settings and output roots. Original six strategies, market/Passive order route, hold, ARC, risk, 150 USD daily staircase and fixed Passive volume remain exact except the declared three entry-feature denominators.
conditional_native.pair: Immediately adjacent complete control and fixed survivor, own physical Optimization Portable only, 100 USD, leverage 1:100, US30 M30 assembly, all three required symbols, Model 4, 100% real ticks, local only and normal shutdown. Freeze all exercised warmup/history/platform/source/model/EX5/SET and native symbol contracts/swaps before/between/after, with complete detailed agent logs. Any environment, design, history or invocation failure requires correction without an arbitrary retry cap; it is not economic rejection.
conditional_native.gates: Higher whole-portfolio actual and doubled-cost/no-positive-financing stressed terminal wealth and geometric growth; nominal stressed gain at least 5%. Native equity DD no greater than adjacent exact control nominally. Effective ceiling is min(control DD+1.5 percentage points,control DD*1.10) and requires stronger growth, recovery and temporal evidence. Every 2025 half, Jan-Jun 2026 and Jul-Aug 2026 must have positive actual and conservative stressed net. Preserve complete equity/capital/quantity/entry/learning/cost/lifecycle paths and flat reconciled results. No multiplying fixed historical trade profits into a compounding claim.
conditional_native.authority: No direct Live promotion. Freeze complete favorable or adverse results and close the whole fixed family before the next macro comparison.

storage.rule: Prove all remaining bounded growth leaves 30 GiB before starting any producing step; reclaim only eligible unowned ignored unreferenced duplicates under retention policy.

prohibitions: Live changes or broker context polling
Closed candidate source, model, training trajectory or state reuse
Test-only infrastructure, CLIs, validators, parity/promotion checkers or CI
